The list of FC 26 leagues, clubs and national teams published on this page is final.


FC 26 Leagues and Clubs


Football is the world’s game, and EA SPORTS FC 26 brings it to life like never before. Immerse yourself in the most authentic football experience, featuring over 20,000 players, more than 750 clubs and national teams, across 120+ stadiums and 35+ leagues, including the sport’s biggest competitions and stars.

The official list of FC 26 leagues and clubs is stated below.

FC 26 Competitions


EA has built the most extensive and comprehensive network of partnerships and licenses in football. As with previous FIFA/FC titles, FC 26 will feature a wide range of competitions worldwide, including national leagues and continental tournaments.

The Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and Ligue 1 are fully exclusive to FC 26, meaning licensed versions will not appear in any other game. Additionally, FC 26 includes several fully licensed international competitions:

  • CONMEBOL Copa Libertadores
  • CONMEBOL Recopa
  • CONMEBOL Sudamericana
  • UEFA Champions League
  • UEFA Europa Conference League
  • UEFA Europa League
  • UEFA Super Cup
  • UEFA Cup of Nations
  • UEFA Euro Championship
Frequently Asked Questions
What leagues are in FC 26?
FC 26 features over 30 leagues, including the five biggest national leagues from Europe. You can see the full list on this page.
What national teams are in FC 26?
It is possible to play with a wide range of national teams in FC26. You can see the full list on this page.
What tournaments are in FC 26?
The Tournament mode in FC 26 allows you to play single-player tournaments of the real countries such as Premier League, FA Cup, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, UEFA Champions League, and CONMEBOL Libertadores, as well as create your custom tournaments.
Is Brazlian league come back to FC 26?
Unfortunately, FC 26 only features a selection of Brazilian clubs with generic player names, and not included in Ultimate Team.
Does FC 26 have Russian clubs?
Following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, EA Sports didn’t include in FC 26:

  • Any Russian Club
    CSKA Moscow, Lokomotiv Moscow or Spartak Moscow
  • Any Russian Stadium
    Otkrytie Arena
  • National Team from Russia and Belarus
Can I edit team names in FC 26?
No, it is not possible to edit club names in FC 26.
